description: An ask of one of a Bot's tasks' runs (task_ask) answered: the Bot's answer_task tool's, or anyone's who may manage the Bot. Taken only for an ask of that run that's waiting on that Bot; the run goes on at once. Refused, with what's wrong, if it doesn't fit the ask's form.

req.description: The request's number, the client's pick: its answers carry it back.

session.description: The Bot's session id: the one the ask's waiting on.

answer.description: An ask with a form: its fields' values, by name.

text.description: An ask with no form: the answer.
